Each product page was compared with the cited old TDS by full-text reading and word-level and number-level differences (scratchpad helper catdiff.py): every number not shared is reported below. The catalogue pages carry no date, so no edition order is assumed. CANDIDATE GAP found here: product codes whose alias is 'generic' (needs the supplier name on the same page) are not linked when the supplier is printed only on the catalogue cover; RF6066, RF6078, RF6079, RF6088, RF6400, RF6406 and RF6408 have pages in these catalogues but no ledger link (see checkpoint 9).
